effects.description: (4 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) When you deal non Critical Damage, you gain a stack of Mechanical Acuity for |cffffff4|r seconds, granting you |cffffff20|r% Critical Strike chance per stack, up to once every |cffffff1|r second and stacking up to |cffffff5|r times. Upon reaching max stacks or after the effect ends, this effect cannot occur again for |cffffff25|r seconds.
